titles.title: The Lottery
titles.plot: This documentary, directed by Madeleine Sackler, shows the tough choices that face inner-city parents regarding their children's education. With public schools, especially in poor areas, often failing to effectively educate children, many parents have turned to charter schools. The film examines the issue and chronicles the journey of four families from Harlem and the Bronx in New York City attempting to overcome the long odds and gain entrance for their children to a successful charter school.

titles.title: The Embalmer
titles.plot: Peppino (Ernesto Mahieux) is a skilled but lonely taxidermist until he crosses paths with Valerio (Valerio Foglia Manzillo), a handsome waiter in search of a better job. Peppino is strangely attracted to the charismatic young man and offers him a cushy position as his apprentice. To curry favor with his pretty-boy aide, Peppino lavishes him with gifts. But when Valerio meets the beautiful Deborah (Elisabetta Rocchetti), a twisted love triangle evolves that can only spell disaster.

titles.title: Crash
titles.plot: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

titles.title: 11 Flowers
titles.plot: In 1975 China, a youngster (Liu Wenqing) has a costly encounter with a fugitive, who steals the boy's new shirt and convinces him to help him escape.

titles.title: Traitors
titles.plot: A musician (Chaimae Ben Acha) agrees to smuggle a drug shipment for some quick cash, but when she meets her traveling companion (Soufia Issami), a captive drug mule, she vows to free her from enslavement to the dealers.

titles.title: A Screaming Man
titles.plot: Aging Adam Ousmane (Youssouf Djaoro), who was once an up-and-coming Chadian swimmer, now manages the pool at a prestigious local resort. When the new Chinese managers of the establishment decide to downsize, Adam loses his job to his own son, Abdel (Dioucounda Koma). Shattered by this demeaning turn of events, Adam is pressured into contributing to the Chadian war effort. With no money to speak of, the only asset he can donate is his son, who is then abducted into the Chadian army.

titles.title: Ajami
titles.plot: A revenge killing has a ripple effect in a multi-ethnic neighborhood in Tel Aviv.

titles.title: As If I Am Not There
titles.original_title: As If I Am Not There
titles.plot: After just moving to Sarajevo, a young woman is imprisoned in a Bosnian war camp.

As If I Am Not There (2009)

titles.title: Beyond the Mountains and Hills
titles.plot: After spending 22 years in the army, an Israeli soldier finds it a challenge to be a civilian in his altered home country.

titles.title: Broken
titles.plot: A girl witnesses a violent attack committed by a neighbor in one of three interconnected stories in a British housing estate.

titles.title: Caught in the Web
titles.plot: Film of a terminally ill woman's mistreatment of a bus passenger goes viral and sparks debate about the intrusiveness of technology and the right to privacy.

titles.title: Girls on the Run
titles.plot: Kathy, a secretive and rebellious teenager, wants only one thing: to escape from the psychiatric facility in which she has been locked up.

titles.title: Court
titles.plot: A social activist who uses folk music to spread his message is arrested, accused of inciting a sewage worker's suicide. Lawyers from both sides of the aisle, and the rote ideologies they represent, are scrutinized as the trial plays out.

titles.title: Dear Wendy
titles.plot: In a blue-collar American town, a group of teens bands together to form the Dandies, a gang of gunslingers led by Dick Dandelion (Jamie Bell). Following a code of strict pacifism at odds with the fact that they all carry guns, the group eventually lets in Sebastian (Danso Gordon), the grandson of Dick's childhood nanny, Clarabelle (Novella Nelson), who fears the other gangs in the area. Dick and company try to protect Clarabelle, but events transpire that push the gang past posturing.

titles.title: Dear You
titles.plot: A debt-ridden grandson travels to Thailand to find the grandfather he believes abandoned their family, hoping the man behind years of qiaopi letters and remittances can help pay his debts. Instead, he uncovers a lifelong act of love and sacrifice. Inspired by overseas Chinese traditions, DEAR YOU has become a breakout success, touching global audiences with its story of family and devotion.

titles.title: Diaz - Don't Clean Up This Blood
titles.original_title: Diaz - Don't Clean Up This Blood
titles.plot: During the 2001 G8 Summit, Italian police initiate a violent crackdown against demonstrators housed at the Diaz Pascoli School.

titles.title: Drunkboat
titles.plot: A teenager (Jacob Zachar) manipulates his troubled, boozy uncle (John Malkovich) into helping him acquire a beaten-up wooden sailboat.

titles.title: The Fool
titles.plot: Dima, a plumber's assistant, is sent to fix a leak in a derelict building and discovers the structure is near collapse. When he notifies the mayor of the situation, he learns other interests come before ordinary citizens.

titles.title: Easier With Practice
titles.plot: An aspiring writer (Brian Geraghty) becomes increasingly obsessed with a phone-sex lover whom he's never actually met in person.

titles.title: Winter of Discontent
titles.plot: Police torture and repression lead to a huge demonstration in Tahrir square.

titles.title: Emotional Arithmetic
titles.plot: Three people who bonded in a detention camp during World War II reunite decades later.

titles.title: Horses of God
titles.plot: After a stint in prison, a young man (Hamza Souidek) becomes a violent Islamic fundamentalist and recruits his younger brother (Abdelhakim Rachid) and the youth's best friend (Abdelilah Rachid) to his cause.

titles.title: Guzaarish
titles.plot: Fourteen years after a paralyzing spinal-cord injury, a magician (Hrithik Roshan) sues for the right to control his fate.

titles.title: Policeman
titles.plot: A member of an Israeli anti-terrorist unit clashes with young radicals.

titles.title: Heroine
titles.plot: A Bollywood superstar struggles with the problems that fame brings her.

titles.title: Ilo Ilo
titles.plot: A hardworking mother (Yann Yann Yeo) becomes jealous of her rambunctious son's (Koh Jia Ler) close bond with his nanny (Angela Bayani).

titles.title: In the Family
titles.plot: After his partner dies in a car accident, a gay man (Patrick Wang) must fight for custody of the boy (Sebastian Brodziak) he's come to love as his own son.

titles.title: La Ultima Oportunidad
titles.plot: As a family faces mounting personal and financial challenges, they must rely on faith, love, and perseverance to overcome the obstacles threatening their future.

titles.title: Light From Light
titles.plot: A single mom working as a part-time paranormal investigator is hired to investigate a widower's farmhouse in Tennessee.

titles.title: Lost and Love
titles.plot: After his young son goes missing, Lei (Andy Lau) begins a 14-year quest to find him. On the road, he meets a repairman (Boran Jing) who suffered the same fate as Lei's son.

titles.title: Mysterious Skin
titles.plot: Two pre-adolescent boys both experienced a strange event and later it affects their lives in different ways. One becomes a reckless, sexually adventurous prostitute, while the other retreats into a reclusive fantasy of alien abduction.

titles.title: Neramu Siksha
titles.plot: A young man, who is the spoilt son of a rich businessman, kills an innocent man during a car race.

titles.title: Nobody Knows About the Persian Cats
titles.original_title: Nobody Knows About the Persian Cats
titles.plot: Two young musicians, Negar (Negar Shaghaghi) and Ashkan (Ashkan Koshanejad), are released from prison. They immediately immerse themselves in the underground rock scene in Tehran, Iran -- "underground" because playing in public venues is outlawed. They plan to escape from their repressive country to play a concert in Europe, but first they need to find a rhythm section and some passports. They place their hope in Nader (Hamed Behdad), a savvy fixer who promises to get them to their gig.

titles.title: Oblivion Verses
titles.plot: When the elderly caretaker of a morgue discovers the body of a young woman killed during a protest, he embarks on a magical odyssey to give her a proper burial before the militia returns.

titles.title: Our Father
titles.plot: Brothers Armine (Hamza Moctar Aguid) and Tahir (Ahidjo Mahamat Moussa) are devastated when their father deserts them. Together, they search for him all over their small town in Chad -- and believe they find him onscreen in one of the movies at the local cinema! After they get caught stealing the film, the boys' exasperated mother, Achta (Zara Haroun), packs them off to a strict boarding school. While the pair plan their escape, Tahir catches the eye of a mute girl (Mounira Khalil).

titles.title: Pursuit of Freedom
titles.plot: The true story of a Ukrainian woman who was sold into trafficking by Russian gangsters, and who against all odds and with the help of a determined Dutch nurse, an Armenian missionary, and an American pastor, survived to be reunited with her three children.

titles.title: Pyromaniac
titles.plot: When a pyromaniac begins setting fires in a peaceful village, a policeman uncovers his shockiing identity.

titles.title: Razzia
titles.plot: Five Moroccans are pushed to the fringes in Casablanca by an extremist government.

titles.title: Respiro
titles.plot: Grazia lives on an island off the coast of Italy with her husband, Pietro, and their three children. Grazia has a reputation in their small fishing village for her manic behavior, but her family stands by her. After Grazia releases all the dogs in the local kennel, however, Pietro is pressured to institutionalize his wife. He refuses, but Grazia runs away anyway, choosing to hide in a cave near the sea.

titles.title: Silenced
titles.plot: Gang In-ho uncovers sexual and physical abuse at a school for hearing impaired children. With the help of a human rights activist, Gang fights against the community to expose the abuse and put a stop to it.

titles.title: Suntan
titles.plot: A middle-aged doctor on a Greek island becomes obsessed with a young tourist when she lets him tag along with her friends.

titles.title: Swades
titles.plot: Mohan Bhargava is a successful NRI working at the technological forefront of NASA in the USA. Driven by nostalgia, he returns to his roots to find the nanny who raised him in his homeland, intending to bring her back to America. His journey leads him into the rural heart of India, to the village of Charanpur, and sets him on both an outward and inner quest to find where he truly belongs.

titles.title: The Imperialists Are Still Alive!
titles.plot: A French party girl (Élodie Bouchez) in Manhattan finds romance on the same night she learns that her childhood friend has disappeared.

images.caption: Élodie Bouchez as Asya and José María de Tavira as Javier in "The Imperialists Are Still Alive."
José María de Tavira as Javier and Élodie Bouchez as Asya in "The Imperialists Are Still Alive."

titles.title: The Fits
titles.plot: An 11-year-old tomboy (Royalty Hightower) tries to fit in with her peers after joining an all-girl dance team.

titles.title: The Forgiveness of Blood
titles.plot: After his father and uncle kill a neighbor, an Albanian teen (Tristan Halilaj) finds that his own life may be forfeited in a legal blood feud.

images.caption: (L-R) Tristan Halilaj as Nik an Elsajed Tallalli as Dren in "The Forgiveness of Blood."

titles.title: The Mountain
titles.plot: Since his mother's confinement to an institution, a man has lived in the shadow of his stoic father. A family acquaintance employs the introverted young man as a photographer to document an asylum tour advocating for his lobotomy procedure.

titles.title: L'immeuble Yacoubian
titles.plot: In a run-down apartment building in downtown Cairo, engineer Zaki Pasha (Adel Emam) and his sister, Dawlat (Issad Younis), live off an inheritance from their father. Another prominent building resident, business magnate Haj Azzam (Nour El-Sherif), hides his second wife while pursuing a career in the Egyptian parliament. Their relatively well-off lives intersect with many others in the building, who struggle with corruption, sexual harassment and general social instability.
